messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 [PAGER] Elevated 5xx rate detected in eu-west-1 — Hosted API + Dedicated pools. error_rate=4.2% at 2026-03-17T09:13:09Z. Affected services: hosted-api-prod, dedicated-pool-eu-west-1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-west1-5xx. Pager: @Ben R, @Carla S.

Ben R: ack, on it. starting quick triage.

Ben R: checking CloudWatch now, STS token latencies spiking, seeing TLS handshake timeouts and 504s on some auth calls.

Dmitri K: adding context — STS latencies jumped ~200ms then some timeouts 504 for token requests from eu-west-1 nodes. Looks like a regional egress/auth provider issue.

Carla S: I'm paged in. Is this impacting Dedicated pools too or just hosted frontends?

Ben R: both. Hosted frontends show increased 5xx, dedicated pools report LB 503s and backpressure.

Alice P: Observability note — Datadog ingest in eu-west appears delayed, dashboards may be stale. Checking Datadog status now.

Eve L: Support: getting customer reports of timeouts, small subset of EU tenants. Logging ticket RED-1543 to track.

Ben R: mitigation plan (immediate): 1) start routing new traffic off eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 (gradual canary). 2) scale fallback Dedicated capacity in eu-central and us-east. 3) enable degraded credential caching to reduce STS calls.

Carla S: I'll create the router change. Ben, prefer canary 10% to start?

Ben R: canary yes. running canary now: `route-control set-weight --service hosted-api-prod --region eu-west-1 --weight 0.9` -> will monitor errors on canary subset.

Ben R: canary telemetry: errors down on canary subset but still intermittent 502s from auth service.

Ben R: rolling to 50% now.

incident-bot: Incident metadata updated: priority=P1, severity=customer-impact, incident-id=INC-20260317-007.

Dmitri K: cross-check: AWS status shows elevated issues around STS TLS handshakes in eu-west-1 — filing link to AWS incident (internal ref).

Carla S: if STS flaky, we should increase local credential TTL. Ben, can you push runtime config to bump cred cache TTL to 10m?

Ben R: yes pushing change now. patch: ```json
{"service":"runtime","change":"CRED_CACHE_TTL","value":"600"}
```

Ben R: change applied. seeing immediate reduction in auth request rate.

Alice P: Datadog still lagging for logs; use CloudWatch metrics/metrics API for real-time if you need fresh data.

Eve L: Support posted initial status page update: "Degraded performance in EU region; engineering investigating." Preparing targeted messages for Dedicated customers.

Carla S: On-call handoff in ~12m. Ben, can you summarize actions to hand over?

Ben R: summary -> 1) Routing weight moved (eu-west ~50% -> eu-central ~50%). 2) Cred cache TTL increased to 600s. 3) Dedicated fallback nodes added in eu-central/us-east and started autoscale. 4) Observability flaky; primary metrics via CloudWatch. 5) Support & status updated. Logs and artifacts at /incidents/INC-20260317-007.

Dmitri K: longer term fix suggestions: add STS client retry/backoff tuning and local auth proxy to reduce surface area; add region-aware cached creds.

Carla S: Handover ack. I'm taking on-call. Ben, please continue watching for 15m and then you can step down.

Ben R: handing to Carla S :wave: I'll stay until the error rate stabilizes under 1%.

Carla S: Taking over oncall until 2026-03-17T10:10Z. Next steps: 1) finish reroute to 100% eu-central if error rate doesn't drop further. 2) escalate AWS support case. 3) run customer impact count by tenant and estimate SLA exposure.

Eve L: Support will compile impacted-tenants list and severity per SLA, send to SRE for action.

incident-bot: AWS support case opened: case-86512. Assigned: Ben R, Carla S.

Carla S: Current status: routing partial (50%), cred cache TTL=600s, dedicated scale triggered. Error rate decreased from 4.2% -> 0.8% over last 6m but latency still elevated for some tenants.

Ben R: provisional ETA: monitoring; recommend keeping status as "degraded" until AWS confirms regional health. Next update in 10m.

Alice P: Adding runbook note for postmortem: root cause hypothesis — STS regional egress/TLS handshake failures producing auth timeouts -> cascading 5xx at LB. Observability ingestion lag contributed to delayed detection.

Eve L: Support summary created for customers, including mitigations and ETA.

Carla S: If AWS doesn't acknowledge in 30m I'll escalate to incident_review. Any concerns?

Dmitri K: no objections.

Carla S: switching dashboards to CloudWatch queries for real-time metrics. Update in 10m.

Ben R: thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: automated update at 2026-03-17T09:25:23Z — incident ongoing, assigned INC-20260317-007.
